queries.result: First-party discovery found Chad's Direction du Cadastre / Service de la Cartographie, official land-procedure documents naming Moundou, the official government portal, CDIG geographic-information portal, and ANATS. No public anonymous Moundou parcel viewer or parcel API was found.

registryEvidence.custodian: Chad Direction du Cadastre / Service de la Cartographie, with cadastral and land-conservation procedure evidence for Moundou
registryEvidence.basis: Official Chad finance-hosted procedure material states that the Direction du Cadastre performs parcel identification, demarcation, parcel-plan preparation and plan updating, and official finance material names Moundou among the covered communes. This evidences a cadastral procedure and national custodian, not a public Moundou geometry service or separately verified local office.

officialSources.scope: Administrative procedure evidence, not an anonymous parcel data endpoint.
